new_statements.second_reader_evidence: Primary quote verified on the page image (printed p. 180 = PDF page 186 of, sec. 2.1 of Steinhauer 1991, 'Demonstratives in the Blagar language of Dolap', PL A-73:177-221, DOI 10.15144/PL-A73.177, CC BY-SA online edition via sealang.net): "Stress is non-phonemic and always on the penultimate vowel/syllable of the phonological word (i.e. word + enclitics if any)." Exact wording matches; one locator detail is off: in the sentence sits at lines 8007-8008, not 7996-7997 (page/section/PDF-page locators are correct; extracted text confirms). Corroborating quote verified on NUSA 4, p. 38, sec. 0, the scanned text): "Stress is non-phonemic and always on the penult." Section context (2.1, phoneme in…
new_statements.rule_in_words: Stress is not contrastive and falls on the penultimate syllable of the phonological word; the domain is the host word plus any enclitics, so when enclitics attach the stress moves to keep the penult of the whole clitic group.
new_statements.exceptions: None stated as lexical exceptions. Steinhauer 1991 (pp. 186-187) notes that certain demonstrative forms (po, do and the ?a?e series) are 'obligatorily stressed and lengthened' in particular syntactic positions, a phrase-level emphasis effect rather than a departure from the penult rule.
new_statements.domain_note: Domain explicitly the phonological word = lexical word + enclitics (1991). Both statements are for the Dolap dialect of Pura island (Blagar of Dolap); the 1977 article is otherwise about motion verbs and the 1991 article about demonstratives, with a one-paragraph phoneme inventory each. Schapper 2020 (survey, held by the project) independently reports 'regular penultimate stress' for Blagar.
new_statements.identity_note: Both quoted sources describe the Blagar of Dolap, a village on Pura island (the Pura dialect of Blagar; Glottolog files Blagar dialects incl. Pura, Tereweng and Bukalabang under blag1240 -- dialect-level glottocode not verified here). Bukalabang (Pantar) has a separate 2020 sketch by Steinhauer, unread. Schapper 2020's survey line 'Blagar.. regular penultimate stress' is consistent with the Dolap statements.
